Imran Shah, imran.shah343@example.com, +91 9850232417
Location: Remote

Professional Summary
Detail-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience hiring across technical and non-technical roles, managing applicant workflows, and supporting payroll integrations. Strong track record of improving time-to-fill and candidate experience through process improvements and Workday-driven automation. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, Workday, Payroll, Linux, Jira, Confluence

Work Experience
Talent Acquisition Specialist, Razorpay (Mar 2023 - Present)
- Managed end-to-end Recruitment for payments and risk teams, leveraging Workday to streamline candidate tracking and reduce time-to-fill for mid-level engineering roles by implementing structured interview templates; coordinated with Payroll for new hire onboarding.
- Designed talent pipelines and proactive sourcing strategies for hard-to-fill roles, using Jira to track hiring sprints and Confluence to document hiring playbooks; improved offer acceptance rates through personalized candidate engagement.
- Partnered with hiring managers to define role requirements and conducted data-driven workforce planning; supported Payroll integrations and ensured accurate new hire data entry in Workday.

Recruiter, Nykaa (Mar 2022 - Feb 2023)
- Executed full-cycle Recruitment for marketing and e-commerce functions, utilizing Workday for requisition management and candidate workflow; coordinated with Payroll to ensure seamless joiner setups.
- Built and maintained candidate pools through targeted sourcing and referral programs, tracked hiring progress in Jira, and maintained hiring documentation in Confluence to standardize interview feedback.
- Collaborated with Talent Acquisition leads to refine interview processes and metrics, contributing to reduced screening bottlenecks and improved hiring velocity.

Education
B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
